evals.name: plan prints and the run starts without a pause
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/demo/issues/ with a valid ticket set and no flag.
evals.expected_output: Preflight confirms a clean Git working tree, plan.mjs validates the tickets, and the Plan lists every ticket with blockers, touch set, seam, matched agent, and risk. The run starts right after the Plan is printed, with no approval pause.
expectations: Prints the Plan with one row per ticket and the retry budget
Starts dispatching after the Plan with no approval pause
Stops before any dispatch on a dirty working tree or a planning error

evals.name: tickets run serially in ascending number
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/serial-demo/issues/ contains four independent tickets.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator runs one ticket at a time in ascending number: worker, optional verifier, squash-merge, gate, then the next ticket.
expectations: Dispatches one worker at a time in ascending ticket number
Starts the next ticket only after the previous gate is green
Offers no parallel, concurrency, or backend option

evals.name: ticket Seam and Context become the worker test boundary and read list
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/context-demo/issues/. Ticket 01 has a Seam and Context field.
evals.expected_output: The worker prompt carries the ticket Seam verbatim as the test boundary and the Context paths as the Read, Change, and Create lists.
expectations: Uses the ticket Seam verbatim as the test seam
Splits Context into read, change, and create paths in the worker prompt

evals.name: first worker command syncs and asserts the integration SHA
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/sync-demo/issues/. The worker worktree was checked out at the wrong commit.
evals.expected_output: The first worker command checks out the worker branch at the integration SHA and asserts HEAD equals it; a mismatch returns failed_infra and counts no ticket attempt.
expectations: Runs the sync as the first command, including for ticket 1
Returns failed_infra on a checkout failure or HEAD mismatch
Counts no ticket attempt

evals.name: verifier runs only for risky tickets
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/demo/issues/. A worker returns a completed report for a Risk: low ticket with complete evidence and no extras. Decide whether to verify.
evals.expected_output: A ticket with no Risk: high, no risk signal, and complete evidence is judged by the orchestrator from the worker evidence and integrated with no verifier. Risk: high, a counted retry, measured extras, an unknown touch set, or incomplete evidence each give a fresh verifier.
expectations: Skips the verifier only when there is no Risk: high, no risk signal, and complete evidence
Treats a Risk: low or missing field as never lowering a risk signal
Counts no attempt for incomplete evidence and dispatches a fresh verifier
Decides after extras are measured and before a verifier would be dispatched

evals.name: fresh native Explore verifier reproduces red and returns raw evidence without a verdict
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/verifier-demo/issues/. A risky ticket's worker returns with a shallow report.
evals.expected_output: A fresh native Explore verifier reproduces red in a scratch checkout, runs the ticket tests, typecheck, and full suite on the worker branch, checks acceptance coverage, and returns raw evidence with no verdict. The orchestrator judges.
expectations: Dispatches a fresh Explore verifier, not the orchestrator or the worker
Reproduces red at the pre-ticket SHA with only the worker's test files
Returns raw evidence and no verdict
Falls back to a fresh general-purpose read-only verifier when the report is too shallow

evals.name: crashes and lost subagents are infra retries outside ticket attempts
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/infra-demo/issues/. A worker is lost before it returns, then the replacement subagent returns.
evals.expected_output: A crash, missing report, or lost subagent is failed_infra and is retried with a fresh child without counting an attempt; after two infra retries the ticket is BLOCKED (TICKET_PROVIDER_FAILED).
expectations: Records failed_infra and retries without counting an attempt
Blocks the ticket with TICKET_PROVIDER_FAILED after two infra retries

evals.name: extras that the criteria do not explain are rejected
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/extras-demo/issues/. A worker for ticket 02 also changed package-lock.json, which the ticket never mentions.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator measures extras from the branch diff, rejects an extra the acceptance criteria do not explain, keeps the worktree and redispatches on a new branch name at the cost of one attempt; an explained extra is accepted, recorded, and makes the ticket risky.
expectations: Measures extras from the git diff, not the worker's list
Rejects an unexplained extra at the cost of one attempt
Rejects an unexplained extra, keeps the attempt's worktree, and redispatches on a new branch name
Accepts an explained extra, records it, and verifies the ticket

evals.name: integration gate squash-merges one commit per ticket and runs the full checks
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/gate-demo/issues/. Ticket 01 passed verification.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator squash-merges the ticket as one commit on the integration branch, then runs the full typecheck and the full test suite before the next ticket.
expectations: Creates exactly one commit per ticket
Runs full typecheck and full test suite after the merge
Starts the next ticket only after a green gate

evals.name: a failing gate rewinds and retries the ticket
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/recovery-demo/issues/. The gate fails after ticket 02 is merged.
evals.expected_output: Ticket 02 is the culprit: the integration branch moves back to the last good commit with git checkout -B, and ticket 02 is redispatched with the failing output at the cost of one attempt.
expectations: Rewinds with git checkout -B, not a hard reset
Redispatches the ticket with the failing output as one attempt
Records the failing check and last good commit in status.md

evals.name: blocked ticket holds dependants and independent tickets continue
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/partial-demo/issues/. Ticket 01 becomes BLOCKED (TICKET_VERIFICATION_FAILED) after three attempts and ticket 03 depends on it.
evals.expected_output: Ticket 03 and every transitive dependant are held; independent tickets continue; the report names each blocked and held ticket and the continue command.
expectations: Holds every transitive dependant of the blocked ticket
Keeps running independent tickets
Names the blocked tickets, held tickets, and /implement-tickets continue <slug>

evals.name: continue reconciles Git and restarts unfinished tickets
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets continue demo. status.md shows ticket 02 verifying and the integration branch one commit behind the recorded commit.
evals.expected_output: continue refuses a status.md without the first line skill: implement-tickets, reconciles recorded commits against Git, rewinds to the last good ticket commit, re-prints the Plan, and restarts ticket 02 from a fresh worker.
expectations: Reconciles recorded commits against Git and rewinds with git checkout -B on drift
Restarts a verifying or dispatched ticket from a fresh worker
Does not re-verify an integrated ticket

evals.name: handoff stops before review and publication
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/handoff-demo/issues/ has passed the final integration gate.
evals.expected_output: The handoff reports the integration branch, review commands, accepted extras, and the tickets that skipped the verifier, then stops before review, push, or pull request creation.
expectations: Does not begin review or publish the branch
Provides the integration branch and next review commands
Lists accepted extras and tickets that skipped the verifier

evals.name: each attempt builds on its own Worker branch
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/retry-demo/issues/. Attempt 1 of ticket 03 failed its gate and its worktree still exists. Dispatch attempt 2.
evals.expected_output: Attempt 1 runs on implement-tickets-work/<slug>/03-a1 and attempt 2 on implement-tickets-work/<slug>/03-a2, so the retry checks out a different branch name from the kept worktree. The worker prompt carries the branch name.
expectations: Names the Worker branch NN-a1 for attempt 1 and NN-a2 for attempt 2 (implement-tickets-work/<slug>/NN-aK)
Has the retry run git checkout -B on a different branch name from the kept attempt's
Puts the per-attempt branch name in the worker prompt

evals.name: infrastructure retries take -iJ branch names and count no attempt
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/infra-demo/issues/. A worker for ticket 02 attempt 1 crashed and its worktree still holds NN-a1. Retry, and retry again when it crashes again.
evals.expected_output: The first infrastructure retry runs on NN-a1-i1 and a further retry on NN-a1-i2, each without counting an attempt; a third failure marks the ticket BLOCKED (TICKET_PROVIDER_FAILED).
expectations: Uses the branch name NN-a1-i1 for the first infrastructure retry
Uses NN-a1-i2 for a further infrastructure retry
Counts no attempt for either retry

evals.name: the Worktree column lists each attempt's path in a fixed grammar
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/column-demo/issues/. Attempt 2 of ticket 02 returned after an attempt 1 and an infrastructure retry; the harness named a different branch for attempt 2.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator writes the Worktree cell when the worker returns, listing each attempt separated by semicolons: a1: <path> for an attempt, a1-i1: <path> for an infrastructure retry, (harness: <branch>) appended when the harness branch differs from the Worker branch, and `?` for a path it could not identify.
expectations: Writes the Worktree cell when the worker returns, not at integration
Writes each attempt as a1: <path> and an infrastructure retry as a1-i1: <path>
Appends (harness: <branch>) when the harness branch differs from the Worker branch
Writes `?` for a path it could not identify

evals.name: a crashed worker's worktree is found by its branch name
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/crash-demo/issues/. A worker for ticket 02 crashed without returning a path.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator reads the worktree list and finds the worktree by matching the attempt's branch name. A crash before the worker created its branch leaves a path it cannot identify, reported as an unknown path in report.md and the handoff.
expectations: Finds the worktree by listing worktrees and matching the attempt's branch name
Reports a crash before the branch existed as an unknown path in report.md and the handoff
Falls back to the worktree list whenever the harness result lacks the path or branch name

evals.name: K and J come from the cell, local branches, and worktree list
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/derive-demo/issues/. Ticket 03 was reset to Attempts 0 but its Worktree cell lists a1 and a2, and a local branch 03-a3 exists from a crashed worker.
evals.expected_output: K for the redispatch is one more than the highest K found in the Worktree cell, the local branches matching implement-tickets-work/<slug>/NN-*, and the worktree list, never from the Attempts column, so the redispatch takes 03-a4. J is derived the same way, and a1-i1 counts as K=1.
expectations: Derives K from the Worktree cell, the local branches, and the worktree list, never from the Attempts column
Takes 03-a4 although Attempts was reset
Parses K from the number after a, so a1-i1 counts as K=1
Derives J the same way

evals.name: the verifier is given the recorded worktree path
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/verify-demo/issues/. A risky ticket 02 returned with its worktree recorded in the Worktree cell.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator gives the fresh verifier the recorded worktree path instead of the branch, because Git will not check out a branch that a live worktree holds. The verifier's own scratch checkout at the pre-ticket SHA stays out of Cleanup.
expectations: Passes the verifier the recorded worktree path, not the branch
Leaves the verifier's scratch checkout out of Cleanup

evals.name: Cleanup removes the worktree, then the branch, after a green gate
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-demo/issues/. Ticket 02 was squash-merged, its gate is green, and its status.md row is written.
evals.expected_output: Cleanup removes the Worker worktree of ticket 02, then the Worker branch, before starting ticket 03. The worktree is removed with the plain form and no force flag; the branch is deleted with the force-delete form because a squash-merge leaves it unmerged.
expectations: Runs Cleanup only after the gate is green and the row is written, before the next ticket starts
Removes the worktree with git worktree remove <path> and no force flag
Deletes the Worker branch with git branch -D because a squash-merge leaves it unmerged

evals.name: Cleanup removes every earlier kept attempt
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-retry-demo/issues/. Attempts 1 and 2 of ticket 03 were kept, attempt 2 also had an infrastructure retry, and attempt 3 integrated.
evals.expected_output: Cleanup removes the worktrees and branches of attempts 1, 2 and 3 in the same pass, including the infrastructure-retry attempt, before the next ticket starts.
expectations: Removes the worktrees and branches of attempts 1 and 2 as well as attempt 3
Includes the infrastructure-retry attempt of attempt 2

evals.name: Cleanup deletes a differing harness branch
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-harness-demo/issues/. The Worktree cell of integrated ticket 02 records (harness: worktree-x) besides the Worker branch.
evals.expected_output: Cleanup deletes the harness branch worktree-x after the worktree is removed, as well as the Worker branch.
expectations: Deletes the recorded harness branch after the worktree is removed
Deletes the Worker branch too

evals.name: Cleanup leaves the Branch and Commit columns as history
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-history-demo/issues/. Cleanup just removed the Worker branch of ticket 02.
evals.expected_output: status.md still shows the Worker branch and squash commit for ticket 02: the Branch and Commit columns are not edited by Cleanup.
expectations: The Branch and Commit columns of ticket 02 are not edited by Cleanup

evals.name: an unknown path is looked up, then reported without removal
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-unknown-demo/issues/. An earlier kept attempt of ticket 03 has a recorded path of ? and attempt 3 integrated.
evals.expected_output: Because the recorded path is `?`, the orchestrator looks the attempt up by its branch name in the worktree list. When it is still not found, it appends a report entry with Step `cleanup` and nothing is removed for that attempt.
expectations: Looks up an attempt whose path is `?` by branch name in the worktree list
Appends a report entry with Step `cleanup` when it is still not found
Removes nothing for that attempt

evals.name: a failed removal is reported and does not stop the run
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-failure-demo/issues/. The worktree removal for ticket 02 fails because the tree holds untracked files.
evals.expected_output: When the worktree removal fails, the orchestrator appends a report entry with Step `cleanup`, still attempts the branch deletion, and starts ticket 03. It does not retry with a force flag.
expectations: Appends a report entry with Step `cleanup`
Still attempts the branch deletion after the failed worktree removal
Starts the next ticket and does not force the removal

evals.name: an already-gone target counts as success
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/cleanup-gone-demo/issues/. The harness already removed the Worker worktree of ticket 02 before Cleanup ran.
evals.expected_output: The worktree is already gone, so it counts as success: no report entry is written and Cleanup continues with the branch and the next ticket.
expectations: Treats an already-gone worktree or branch as success
Writes no report entry for it

evals.name: a failed gate keeps the attempt's worktree
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/keep-gate-demo/issues/. Attempt 1 of ticket 03 failed its gate and the orchestrator rewinds the integration branch.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator rewinds and redispatches ticket 03 with the failing output. The Worker worktree of attempt 1 is not removed, and attempt 2 runs on a new branch name.
expectations: Does not remove the Worker worktree of the attempt that failed its gate
Redispatches the retry on a new branch name

evals.name: a verifier rejection keeps the attempt's worktree
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/keep-verifier-demo/issues/. The verifier returns raw evidence for ticket 03 and the orchestrator judges it insufficient.
evals.expected_output: When the orchestrator judges that the verifier rejects ticket 03, it keeps the attempt's worktree and redispatches on a new branch name at the cost of one attempt. Nothing says the branch is discarded.
expectations: Keeps the worktree of the attempt the verifier rejected
Redispatches on a new branch name and counts one attempt

evals.name: a non-mechanical merge-conflict redispatch keeps the old worktree
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/keep-conflict-demo/issues/. Squash-merging ticket 03 hits a merge conflict the orchestrator cannot resolve without changing behavior.
evals.expected_output: After a non-mechanical merge conflict, the orchestrator redispatches ticket 03 from the latest integration commit at the cost of one attempt. It keeps the old worktree and the new attempt takes a new branch name.
expectations: Keeps the old attempt's worktree after a non-mechanical merge conflict
Takes a new branch name for the redispatch

evals.name: a BLOCKED ticket keeps all its worktrees
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/keep-blocked-demo/issues/. Ticket 04 exhausted its attempts and became BLOCKED, and the run ends.
evals.expected_output: A BLOCKED ticket keeps all its attempts' worktrees. Run end removes none of them; they stay for inspection before continue.
expectations: Keeps every attempt worktree of the BLOCKED ticket
Removes none of the kept worktrees at run end

evals.name: the handoff names every leftover worktree
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/keep-handoff-demo/issues/. One worktree removal failed, ticket 04 is BLOCKED, and one recorded path is unknown.
evals.expected_output: The handoff lists every worktree left behind by path: the worktrees of BLOCKED ticket 04, the worktree of the failed removal, and the unknown path (`?`).
expectations: Lists the worktree paths of the BLOCKED ticket and of the failed removal in the handoff
Includes an unknown path among the leftovers
